facts.text: From the Chewuch River trail, the Lesamiz Trail climbs to the Boundary Trail just short of Upper Cathedral Lake, a way in used on both a July and a September trip.
In late September the north gully down to Cathedral Pass is loose scree over hard ground and slick enough to cause falls; descend it with care.

notes: No track qualified: every Peakbagger ascent here is a multi-peak or camp-based trip (Cathedral/Remmel combined) or lacks track data, and none is a trailhead round trip tied to one of our routes. Candidates for partial climb lines if the owner wants them: 2573808 (Pilgrimage to Mecca, Jul 2024), 1418871 (North Ridge, Jul 2020), 2654844 (Southwest route, Sep 2024). Peak summit pin (48.9756,-120.1922) matches Peakbagger (48.97566,-120.192342). Andrews Creek TH pin not re-confirmed because no track nominated a move. Finger of Fatwa and both Middle Finger Buttress routes have no usable logs.
